info.title: Lobster Gacha API
info.description: Provably fair Solana gacha API with Phoenix perpetuals market data. Payments are USDC-denominated via x402/pay.sh on Solana.

post.summary: Execute a provably fair gacha pull
post.description: Execute 1x or 10x provably fair gacha pull returning AI agent cards with rarity tiers (Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary), CLAWD token prizes, and a SHA-256(wallet:spinIndex:blockhash) commitment hash for on-chain verification. Requires x402/pay.sh payment of $0.0025 USDC per request.

count.description: Number of pulls. 10x pulls guarantee ≥ Rare on the final card.

200.description: Gacha result containing agent cards with rarity, prizes, and commitment hash

rarity.description: Card rarity. Drop rates: Common 60%, Rare 25%, Epic 12%, Legendary 3%.

narrative.description: AI-generated card lore (model chosen from commitment hash)

spinIndex.description: Sequential pull index for this wallet

nftMint.description: Metaplex Core NFT mint address if minting was requested

totalClawd.description: Total CLAWD prizes won across all cards

402.description: Payment required. Include an x402/pay.sh Payment header with $0.0025 USDC proof on Solana.

400.description: Invalid request (missing wallet, invalid count, or malformed pubkey)

get.description: Proxy to Phoenix DEX perpetuals with technical analysis. Returns ticker, funding rates, OHLCV candles, and TA indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands) for SOL, BTC, and ETH pairs. Requires x402/pay.sh payment of $0.001 USDC per request.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description:
Command path. Examples:
- `market/ticker/SOL` — live price, 24h volume, funding rate
- `market/candles/SOL?interval=1h` — OHLCV candles
- `market/candles/SOL?interval=1h&with_indicators=rsi,macd` — candles + TA
- `ta/report/SOL&timeframe=1h` — full TA report (RSI, MACD, BBands)

Supported assets: SOL, BTC, ETH

200.description: Market data or TA indicators response

schema.description: Response shape varies by cmd. Ticker returns price/volume/funding; candles return OHLCV arrays; ta/report returns RSI, MACD, and Bollinger Band values.

402.description: Payment required. Include an x402/pay.sh Payment header with $0.001 USDC proof on Solana.
